entries.title: A crewmate's report that quotes translations is kept
entries.body: A crewmate that quoted words in several languages, such as a Japanese and an Arabic translation beside English, had its report set aside and its turn counted as failed. Those reports now reach your first mate. A report with a single garbled word, mixing unrelated alphabets, is still set aside.
entries.noPicture: This changes which crewmate reports are accepted, not a view or control.
